selected_problem: Fresh-main reality testing found validation inference only inspected the root package.json. An npm workspace could have a passing root check while a child workspace declared a failing test; inference returned only npm run check, allowing the root result to mask the child failure.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed four-mode router selects DEEP_DEVELOPMENT through the singular evidence-rich central bottleneck gate; no forced mode rotation was used.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. Selection/routing use committed DWAC source-contract replay over fresh canonical main while the provider remained transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.workspace: Root package.json declares npm workspaces and a passing check script; packages/app/package.json declares a failing test script.
pre_fix_reproduction.observed: inferValidationCommands returned only [npm run check], so child workspace test evidence was absent from acceptance.

changes: When a root package declares npm workspaces and at least one standard root validation script, inference composes root and workspace execution for the bounded standard validation categories check/test/lint/typecheck/build.
Each validation category remains one shell command by composing root --if-present and --workspaces --if-present execution, keeping the existing eight-command acceptance budget intact.
Non-workspace package inference retains its previous exact command form and ordering.
A regression proves a passing root check no longer masks a failing child workspace test.

validation.validation_note: Focused local validation used the exact branch acceptance source with a compatible one-shot runCommand harness. The test executed real npm workspace commands: root check passed and the child workspace test exited non-zero, producing COMMAND_FAILED.

truth_boundaries: This closes a concrete npm-workspaces masking path; it does not claim exhaustive monorepo discovery for pnpm, Yarn, nested Python projects or arbitrary build systems.
A workspace root with no standard root validation script still fails safe with NO_VALIDATION_EVIDENCE rather than guessing that no-op workspace commands are meaningful evidence.
The current validation execution budget remains eight commands.
OS-level filesystem/network sandboxing, Windows descendant-tree equivalence, arbitrary complex semantic synthesis and crash-level filesystem atomicity remain unresolved.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
